mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(MAX(v.boundary),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'),'NONE') FROM ( SELECT valid_from AS boundary FROM permission_grant g WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) UNION ALL SELECT valid_to AS boundary FROM permission_grant g WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND valid_to <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) UNION ALL SELECT valid_from AS boundary FROM rights_revision r WHERE valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) UNION ALL SELECT valid_to AS boundary FROM rights_revision r WHERE valid_to <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) v

SELECT h.config_id AS id,h.current_version AS version_id FROM configuration_head h JOIN model_config_revision m ON m.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND m.config_id=h.config_id AND m.model_config_revision=h.current_version AND m.project_id <=> h.project_id AND m.configuration_kind='MODEL' AND m.execution_mode=h.execution_mode WHERE h.kind='MODEL' AND h.execution_mode=#{mode} AND h.current_version IS NOT NULL AND h.config_id > #{after} AND (LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(h.config_id)) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(m.provider)) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(m.model_id)) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(m.model_version)) > 0) ORDER BY h.config_id

SELECT r.rule_version AS id,r.rule_version AS version_id FROM rule_version r JOIN rule_definition d ON d.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND d.rule_version=r.rule_version WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM simulation_rule_binding b WHERE b.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND b.rule_version=r.rule_version) AND r.rule_version > #{after} AND (LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(r.rule_version)) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(r.engine_revision)) > 0) ORDER BY r.rule_version
